observations: Test harness creates a per-instance SQL Server test database under E:\SqlData\Tests; constructor supports reusing another factory database and marks only the creator as owner.
Factory configures real server and EF connection string; test helper methods seed users, product/pricing/recipe and treasury/business-day rows, and provide query access.

TokenFor writes a session row when called; this is fixture behavior executed only by tests. Dispose drops only an owned test database. No financial business handler logic is implemented by this fixture.
risks_and_limits: No SQL was executed and no test database was created or modified during this static review.
SQL Server path/permissions, database lifecycle, migrations, and seed behavior were not runtime-validated.
Reuse name and identifier interpolation are test-harness inputs, not production request paths; no claim of production SQL injection was made.

assessment.reason: Reviewed fixture methods serve isolated test setup/authentication/seed/query/disposal. Source shows separate generated DB names and owner-aware cleanup, but execution was not tested. Not an application persistence path.
assessment.recommendation: No change recommended from this file-only static pass.
